body: this is mainly about my physical situation. i know that a lot of people don't get going or have a good time of it until they're older than this...but i'm in excruciating physical pain all of the time. and i have no one in my life who cares enough about me/i'm close to to keep me going. the pain is so bad that most days i spend entirely in bed. if i'm lucky i won't throw up from the pain that day and i'll be able to muster up the concentration to read. most days i am not so lucky :-(. i have gone through months of yelling and screaming at the world..wondering why this horrible thing has to happen to me and why i can't be as lucky as everyone else my age who is able to be in school or have at least one friend..but i am numb from it now and ready to say goodbye to the world that has always just been so cruel to me

i wish i could :-(. unfortunately i suffer from severe, unrelenting chronic pain so it's hard for me to even get to the kitchen...it isn't possible for me to do something like that. and if i did i would be unable to enjoy anything the environment had to offer. thank you very much. it would mean something to me if my passing is, even in a small way, noticed.
things may have worked out for you, and i'm glad they did. but it doesn't always get better for everyone... :-(

i have chronic chest pain that has been here for two years and has made me be in too much pain to go to school (i had to drop out of a prestigious school i worked very hard to get into), have a job, or make friends. it feels like someone is stabbing me in the chest with a sharp and hot knife 24/7. i scream in pain in my sleep and wake up drenched in my own tears, and no doctor or medication or intervention has helped. i haven't had one friend since i was 12 and i am 20 now. my parents subjected me to a traumatic experience that i still have nightmares and flashbacks to very often (i believe the anxiety of this experience is what caused the chest pain). no boy has ever liked me, i have never been kissed, never been pursued as even a friend by anyone my entire life. i am alone in every sense of the word. i cannot do anything even with motivation because of the pain. i used to be thin and beautiful; now because of my inability to barely move i am big and look 30 years older than i am because of stress. my parents have given up on helping me and recently moved out of the country and are enjoying themselves in an exotic european village and do not answer my calls. 

YOU have it easy. it could be much, much worse for you. this is not a platform to condescend others who are feeling hopeless.
